events.title: Yemeni government and Houthis trade attacks across several fronts, both claim heavy losses
events.caption: Government forces, in a counteroffensive they call Operation Dawn of Yemen, say they hit Houthi positions in Lahij, Taiz, Marib, al-Jawf, Hajjah and al-Bayda and killed or wounded about 190 fighters. The Houthis say Saudi-backed forces launched 109 air and missile attacks and claim strikes on Riyadh and an Aramco facility. Al Jazeera could not verify either side's claims. WHO says at least 1,771 killed and 7,959 wounded in Yemen since August. Marker is placed at Marib.

events.title: Tanker ablaze in eastern Hormuz; Iran says it hit a mine
events.caption: UKMTO reported a tanker incident in the Strait of Hormuz; the extent of damage and the crew's condition were not yet known. Al Jazeera notes UKMTO reported two tankers, one hit by an unknown projectile northeast of Lima, Oman. Marker is placed at Khasab, not the exact position.

lanes.name: Strait of Hormuz
lanes.text: Restricted since Feb 28. Nov 11: Iran's army and IRGC say tankers burned after hitting mines on an unauthorised route in the eastern strait; UKMTO reported incidents involving two tankers. Iran's security chief says Hormuz stays shut until the US meets Iran's conditions; the US says it is open to diplomacy. Monitoring firms count at least 37 attacks on ships in and near the strait in November, the highest monthly total of the war (per Al Jazeera).

US/Israel - Iran
stats.headline: Paused, two tracks
stats.text: Qatari mediators back in Tehran Oct 30 (Reuters). Vance letter to Rezaei proposed direct talks; Iran has not replied and holds to its seven conditions (Tasnim via ISW). Trump says the outreach was about medical supplies. CENTCOM's Adm. Cooper briefed Trump on military options at the White House (WSJ via CNBC). US envoy Tom Barrack says a deal on a process is 'very close' but more strikes remain possible.

stats.label: Israel - Gaza
stats.headline: Ceasefire, stalled
stats.text: One year on: no stabilisation force, aid at about a third of the agreed rate, Israel controls nearly two thirds of the Strip.

stats.label: Israel - Lebanon
stats.headline: Framework, strikes continue
stats.text: Truce Jun 19 and framework Jun 26; Israeli forces still hold part of the south; CENTCOM technical talks Oct 21-22.

stats.label: Houthis - Saudi
stats.headline: Active war
stats.text: 2022 UN truce shattered. Houthis claimed six attacks on Saudi Arabia Oct 29 despite the Tehran meeting where Saudi Arabia and Iran agreed to keep talking. Yemen's government asked the UN Security Council to act over attacks on Aden airport.

stats.label: Israel politics
stats.headline: Hung parliament
stats.text: Oct 27 election: Netanyahu bloc 53 of 120; 61 needed.

stats.label: Brent crude oil price
stats.note: Brent settle, USD/bbl, selected October dates. October range $100.20 to $116.72. Pre-war about $72. Oct 29 fell on US-Iran talk hopes; still the sixth-highest settle of 2026, up 11% this month (MarketWatch). December Brent expires Oct 30; OPEC+ meets Sunday.

stats.label: Hormuz traffic

rows.value: ~19 commodity vessels/day in 10 days to Oct 21 vs 100+ pre-war; crude ~8.5M bpd 7-day avg (Oct 16)
Helped Gulf states export 1.5 billion barrels via Hormuz since summer

stats.note: The ANZ figure is via a secondary compilation (GlobalSecurity). Vessel counts and oil volumes are not directly comparable. IMO counted 34 confirmed attacks on vessels from Sep 28 to Oct 27, mostly in Hormuz (via Seatrade). CNBC says traffic is at single-digit daily passings.

stats.label: Other energy & transport signals
stats.text: Houthi attacks have grounded nearly 90% of flights at Riyadh airport (Reuters, via Al Jazeera on X, Oct 29). Air France extended its Riyadh and Dubai suspension. QatarEnergy is buying US LNG to hedge Hormuz disruption (Reuters on X, Oct 29). Pentagon told lawmakers the war has cost at least $47.1bn (via Al Jazeera on X).
